lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, following a semi-regular grid pattern along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming discernible grid-like anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin silhouette, exhibiting lower density than the lateral flank regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped indentation or notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin, indicating an area of missing tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple thin, elongated low-luminance objects (remoras) are visible trailing near the ventral and pectoral fin regions.
